title: Warm Potato Salad with {p} and {v}
steps: Cut the {s} into bite-size pieces and boil in salted water until just tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain and let steam dry for a few minutes.
Cook the {p} until {doneness}{?egg:, boiling the eggs hard for 10 minutes and chopping them}, then let cool a little.
Toss the warm {s} with the {sauce}, the {spice} and the {v}.
Fold in the {p} and serve warm or cold.
tip: Use a mustard and vinegar dressing instead of mayonnaise, and add plenty of crunchy vegetables.
